findings.title: Apply the website visibility restriction to website_name
findings.body: The new website_name attribute is not included in untrusted_attributes, and include_website_name lacks the trailing `?` required for a serializer inclusion predicate. Consequently, anonymous requests for TL0 profiles receive the website hostname (and, for matching domains, its path) even when scope.restrict_user_fields? suppresses website itself. The updated template also displays that restricted information. Add website_name to the same visibility guard as website and use a correctly named inclusion predicate.

findings.title: Refresh the website label when saving profile changes
findings.body: The label now comes from the server-populated website_name instead of a computed property dependent on model.website. User.save() sends the changed website but only copies bio_excerpt from the response; it never updates website_name. After changing or clearing a website on the loaded user model, the profile can therefore show the old domain with a new or empty link target, or keep a newly added website hidden, until user details are fetched again. Update website_name from the save response or otherwise recompute it when website changes.
